This '''[[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]''' was a short encounter that took place at the corner of [[Rainbow Parkway]] and [[Gallery Row]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].

==Prelude==
Three [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]], [[Yral Chael]], [[Mas Sirrah]], and [[Probus Tesla]], were sent by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to find [[Jax Pavan]] and [[I-5YQ]]. The Inquisitors were equipped with [[Taozin amulet]]s, which made them almost invisible in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Near the corner of [[Rainbow Parkway]] and [[Gallery Row]] they felt [[Kajin Savaros]]'s Force presence, and decided to attack. Kajin, who had been walking with [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Dejah Duare]] and [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]], had the other two run off to safety as he prepared to fight. However, moments before the outbreak of the battle, [[Laranth Tarak]] arrived on the scene to help the young [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[I-5YQ]], were not far behind, having hitched a ride to the scene on [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Police]] prefect [[Pol Haus]]'s [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]].

==The duel==
Jax squared up with Yral, Laranth with Sirrah, and Kajin with Probus. A short battle ensued, and Yral almost hit Pavan with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], but he was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by I-5YQ's fingertip [[Laser/Legends|lasers]]. In the chaos, however, Laranth had lost track of Sirrah, and the Inquisitor jumped off a nearby roof, coming at her from above and behind, about to shoot off a deadly storm of Force lightning. Savaros saw him at the last second, however, and hit Sirrah with a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force Push]] so strong it literally vaporized the Inquisitor. This, however, allowed Tesla to escape.

==Aftermath==
Tesla became even more impressed with Kajin's skills, but he also noticed that he could sense I-5YQ, as if the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]. He reported to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] told him that capturing Savaros was the new priority, for with his capture would come the capture of Pavan, I-5, and the [[Bota/Legends|bota]] serum. Vader also revealed that one of Jax's friends was actually a double agent, working for the Empire.

Jax also realized that he could sense I-5, and he told the droid that their plot to assassinate the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] could not succeed, for the droid's intentions would be sensed. The group then decided to send Kajin to the [[Whiplash]] leader [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], and they also found that [[Den Dhur]] had finally left for his [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] and his lover, [[Eyar Marath]].
